submitted.rationale: EQE was flat and low (~0.003%) from Sb 0.31 to 0.69, which covers the Cu2SbO5 and CuSb2O6 regions. It rose sharply on the Sb-rich side: 0.012% at Sb 0.83 and 0.127% at Sb 0.889, roughly 10x higher. Index 26 is the best measured composition. The optimum may lie at or just past Sb ~0.89, where CuSb2O6 is mixed with antimony oxide.
